limitations.text: The Commons bronze vector direct URL in the acquisition findings returned 404 and is excluded. The Commons oracle file’s source and rights metadata were not adequately verified in the supplied dossier; Xiaoxuetang returned 401 for the per-character query. Open ACC has a general collection description but no verified 考 record or reuse terms. Consequently there is no alternative image with both established identity and reuse provenance to propose.
